sources.facts: Rajaraja II’s all-stone Airavatesvara temple, 24 m sanctuary tower, and the chariot conception of the Rajagambhiran tirumandapam.
Named hall arrangement, highly ornate pillars and sanctum, chariot mandapa wheels and sculpted work.
Directory of Monuments in Tamilnadu, Airavateswara entry. Standing stone vimana has five storeys and the porch is a stone horse-drawn chariot.
Text on the architecture of four great temples describes the Darasuram east-west axis, sanctum, connecting ardha-mandapa, closed maha-mandapa, open agra-mandapa and subordinate south porch.
